name: @jeffreyjyz/opencode-command-code
description: Command Code provider + usage dashboard for opencode: two providers (Anthropic wire for Claude, OpenAI wire for everything else) against api.commandcode.ai, live model list, plan gating, /cmd-usage. Requires the cmduse CLI for usage rendering.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode/plugin --external @opencode/plugin/tui && bun build src/tui.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode/plugin --external @opencode/plugin/tui && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
